sloka: सुवर्णमणिमुक्तेन प्रवालेन च शोभिता: ।आगुर्विंशतिसाहस्रा: कुबेरप्रहिता: स्त्रिय: ॥ २.९१.४३॥
transliteration: suvarṇamaṇimuktena pravālena ca śobhitā: ।āgurviṁśatisāhasrā: kuberaprahitā: striya: ॥ 2.91.43॥

translations.english: At that very moment twenty thousand women adorned with beautiful ornaments sent by Brahma presented themselves.
